svg.text: Everyday English - Vocabulary
streamline
US /ˈstriːm.laɪn/
MEANING
To make a process more efficient by removing
unnecessary steps or complexity.
IN CONTEXT
We streamlined the approval process by replacing
three separate forms with one.
USAGE NOTE
Streamline takes an object: streamline a workflow,
service, or procedure. It emphasizes how something
operates, rather than simply doing it faster. Simplify is
broader; an explanation can be simplified without being
streamlined. Avoid claiming efficiency if you have only
moved work onto someone else.
CONVERSATION
A: These requests pass through four different teams.
B: Could we streamline the approval process?
A: We could remove the duplicate review.
B: That would save time without skipping the
necessary checks.
YOUR TURN
Improve this proposal using streamline: We should
remove duplicate forms and unnecessary approvals.
Model: We should streamline the process by removing
duplicate forms and unnecessary approvals.
